select aa.ID as id, aa.DEPARTMENTNAME as name,aa.SUBCOMPANYID1 as pid, bb.SUBCOMPANYNAME as pidName,aa.SUPDEPID as supDeptId from hrmdepartment aa left join hrmsubcompany bb on aa.SUBCOMPANYID1 = bb.id where (aa.CANCELED = 0 or aa.CANCELED is null) and aa.SUPDEPID = 0
and aa.ID = cast(#{deptId} as unsigned)
order by aa.SHOWORDER
